revision_summary: One quote-location fix and one schema-classification fix needed before ship. (1) In script_coverage's address_homeowner entry, the customer_quote 'I don't know about the credit score, but I definitely know I own the owner.' is timestamped at 00:20 but actually occurs at 01:28 — 00:20 is the rep's address-confirmation line. Correct the ts to 01:28 (or split the entry so the address question ts stays at 00:20 and the customer response reflects the actual homeownership confirmation exchange around 01:28-01:32). (2) Reclassify cherry_pick_moments[3] (ts 01:37) away from 'objection_inversion_miss' — the objection_inversion schema mechanism is scoped to cost/time/interest objection trigger phrases, and a self-reported credit uncertainty doesn't fit that trigger set. Reframe this moment under qualifiers.credit_qualifier's stated-vs-pulled-credit policy question instead. While revising, add the two missed-moment flags: (a) the roof age (15 years) sits exactly on the dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement boundary and should be noted as a second live DQ criterion in this call; (b) the credit-DQ rests on Lawanda's guess about Neil's (the actual lead's) credit, not even her own — a proxy-guess DQ, which sharpens the coaching_focus priority-1 point considerably and should be called out explicitly. Also fix the script_coverage section mislabeled 'tax_credit_qualifier' when it actually documents the credit_score qualifier exchange — no tax credit disclosure occurred at all in this call.
